title: okr-template template variables
description: Values for templates/okr-template.md.j2 and templates/okr-template.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from okr-template.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

date.title: Date
date.description: The date these were committed, ISO. Anything added after it is a mid-quarter change and should be visible as one, rather than appearing to have been the plan all along.

kill_condition_one.title: Kill condition one
kill_condition_one.description: The leading indicator that, if it has not moved by week 6, means you drop this Objective. Deciding it now is the only real defence against spending a whole quarter on a dead bet.

objective_one.title: Objective one
objective_one.description: The first Objective as a statement of the change you want, not a number. If it reads like a Key Result you have written the target and skipped the reason anyone should care about it.

objective_one_owner.title: Objective one owner
objective_one_owner.description: The single person accountable for Objective 1. Not the team. The owner is who calls the kill condition, and a committee has never killed anything on time.

quarter.title: Quarter
quarter.description: The period, e.g. "Q4 2026". Scoring happens against this window; an undated OKR sheet becomes a wish list that rolls forward until it is quietly deleted.
